entities.name: PROCEDURE TRANSACTION INACTIVE
entities.description: State where no procedure transaction is active between network and UE.

entities.name: PROCEDURE TRANSACTION PENDING
entities.description: State where the network has initiated a procedure transaction towards the UE and is awaiting response.

entities.name: network initiated ESM procedure request
entities.description: Condition triggered when network initiates an ESM procedure request towards the UE.

entities.name: ESM procedure response by the UE
entities.description: Condition triggered when UE sends a response to the network-initiated ESM procedure.

relations.description: Network initiated ESM procedure request transitions state from INACTIVE to PENDING.
ESM procedure response by the UE transitions state from PENDING to INACTIVE.
State transition from INACTIVE to PENDING triggered by network initiated ESM procedure request.
State transition from PENDING to INACTIVE triggered by ESM procedure response by the UE.
